title: Print a scoreboard line
prompt: `player` is a supplied string and `score` is a supplied whole number. Print one line with the player, a colon and a space, then the score, as in `Ana: 2`. When player is the empty string, print `Guest` in its place. When score is 0, print the word `none` in its place. Both rules can apply to the same line.
hints: The two rules are independent. Does your code handle each one whatever the other does?
Work out the name part and the score part separately, each with its own if, then print them together.
Use one string variable for the name and one for the score text. Change each only when its own rule applies.
checkLabels: The line must show the player or Guest, a colon and a space, then the score or none.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats the two rules as one: an empty player always prints none.
Handles the empty player but not the zero score.

feedback: Find the failing case and check each half of the line on its own. The player rule and the score rule do not depend on each other.
